notes.title: Fledge - Update 1.1 - Save System Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Patch Notes for Update 1.1

After extensive testing, it was found that the save system malfunctioned after completely exiting the game.

Fixes:

Fixed the save system. Your progress is now correctly saved.
Fixed a bug related to Corentin's scarf after using a teleporter.
If your game does not launch when pressing "Continue," please restart the game. The old save file may be corrupted. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Sincerely,

The Fledge Team
